note: V1FINC v94: Assets/Editor/V1FinisherClipSetup.cs reads this. Editor-only (listed in build.editorOnlyData). Imports the 3 V1 finisher GLBs and adds each as an Animator state on the roster characters named in `targets` (roles @player / @enemy or a roster id). The per-character retarget numbers (referenceState, hipsRestZ, hipsCorrection) are NOT repeated here: they come from finishers.json clipImport.characters, the controller and the output folder from roster.json. State ids are the ones FinisherPlayer.ApplyV1Clips looks up (finishers.json entries[].clipsV1). Rig: the GLBs are Mixamo-named stand-ins (Armature/root/mixamorig:*, same family as fin_beheading_k: hipsRestZ 1.042749, hips z -0.857 at frame 0); the clips are rebuilt as GENERIC transform curves remapped by bone leaf name onto each controller's own reference clip paths (Joan Armature/root/..., Pitborn Rig/root/...), exactly like the live finisher clips. No Humanoid avatar is involved.
